Yashswey Chouhan 
Process Governance  |  Operational Risk & Controls  |  Middle Office Operations 
Mobile: +91 9167550460 / 9167550459  |  Email: yashsweyc@gmail.com 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Operations and Governance professional with 10+ years of experience in global investment banking, specialising 
in end-to-end process governance, operational risk and control frameworks, and cross-functional business 
transformation. Proven track record owning governance artefacts (SOPs, RACIs, process maps), leading root 
cause analysis and incident management, and driving sustainable corrective actions. Skilled in managing issue 
and action logs to closure, and delivering MI/KPIs to senior leadership. Experienced in partnering with Risk, 
Compliance, Technology, and Audit teams to embed regulatory requirements into governance frameworks across 
EMEA, US, and APAC. Delivery-oriented with strong stakeholder management, attention to detail, and a 
demonstrated ability to drive process standardisation, simplification, and measurable operational improvements 
under tight deadlines. 
 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
Operational Migration & Process Governance Framework: Led migration of EMEA middle office functions 
from London to Bangalore; designed and implemented a new governance and risk management framework — 
including process documentation, escalation paths, and control standards — reducing operational risk by 12%. 
Issue & Action Management / Control Gap Remediation: Drove ~3% month-on-month reduction in trade 
mismatches/breaks across ~17,000 monthly trades through root cause analysis, and targeted process 
improvements. 
Governance MI & Operational Health Reporting: Built and maintained critical KPI/KRI dashboards and 
performance reports for senior management, enabling data-driven governance decisions and a 65% reduction in 
confirmation delays. 
Business Continuity Planning & Implementation: Led BCP coordination with the Central Risk Management 
Team across EMEA, US, and APAC functions, ensuring end-to-end continuity coverage for critical trade 
operations and governance processes with no breaches to service levels 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Senior Associate  |  Goldman Sachs  |  Bangalore Jan 2022 – Feb 2026 
Securities Operations – Interest Rate Derivatives – Trading Middle Office 
 
• Designed, monitored, and strengthened operational controls to reduce risk and improve control 
effectiveness; drove measurable ~3% month-on-month reduction in trade mismatches across ~17,000 
monthly trades. 
• Contributed to the Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process by providing input to the Risk team on 
control effectiveness, identifying operational risk indicators, and ensuring front-to-back process controls 
were accurately represented in the firm's risk framework 
• Led root cause analysis (RCA) for operational incidents and exceptions; captured lessons learned and drove 
sustainable corrective and preventive actions to closure 
• Ensured adherence to regulatory requirements (Mandatory Clearing, SEF execution); partnered with Risk 
and Compliance to embed regulatory and conduct expectations into operational governance 
• Provided governance MI and performance insights to senior leadership, enabling proactive risk identification 
and continuous improvement in execution quality. 
• Supported business continuity planning and implementation in coordination with the Central Risk 
Management Team; ensured governance artefacts remained current and audit-ready 
• Owned end-to-end process governance framework across global Interest Rate Derivatives trading 
operations, including process documentation, RACI, escalation paths, and control inventory across EMEA 
 
Associate  |  Goldman Sachs  |  Bangalore Nov 2019 – Dec 2021 
Securities Operations – Interest Rate Derivatives Confirmation 
 
• Served as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the end-to-end automation of the broker-trader reconciliation 
process; collaborated with Technology teams to design and implement an automated reconciliation tool for 
same-day broker trade bookings, driving a ~65% reduction in reconciliation processing time, eliminating 
manual touchpoints and significantly lowering operational risk 
• Led issue triage and action management for economic and legal discrepancies in Interest rate derivatives 
trades, conducting structured RCA and driving process improvements that resulted in a 65% reduction in 
confirmation delays. 
• Produced KPI/KRI dashboards and operational health reports for senior management to support governance 
decisions and track remediation progress. 
Senior Analyst |  HSBC |  Bangalore Sep 2015 – Oct 2019 
Pricing, Global Banking and Markets 
 
• To centralize the market data source at one point i.e. creating a golden source across different regions. 
Aimed at upgrading current methodology for price update across different systems i.e. Summit, Calypso, 
and Murex, thus reducing redundancy with improved efficiency and transparency  
• Working as Business analyst for Trade operation, Reference data to ensure trade quality is 
maintained/improved and errors are eliminated 
• Managing risk by constantly liaising with trading desk and product control for resolving issues related  
to daily market price upload 
• Exception clearing of the trade wherein right broker prices not available for the product and highlighting the 
trade to product control team for correct broker source 
• Daily/weekly reporting of the volumes and exception handling, working on monthly dashboards for senior 
management updates 
• Analysing prices for various products like Swaps, FX, Futures & Bonds through Stale-variance reports,  
rates comparisons with different benchmark sources like Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters & MarkIT 
 
Analyst (CIP)  |  Goldman Sachs  |  Bangalore Mar 2015 – Jun 2015 
Client Implementation Management – GSAM 
 
• Supported operational efficiency by helping set up 15 new GSAM client relationships, accounts, and funds. 
• Assisted in managing three fixed-income, equity, and hedge share classes, contributing to portfolio 
efficiency improvements. 
• Participated in process reengineering to help execute operational strategies.
